node.title: Re^2: Generate a regex from text
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [LanX|Rolf] & [porg],

$re = join "|", map quotemeta, @column

Shameless plug - I recently wrote the node [id://1179840] on exactly this topic (keep in mind it is still a draft). Also, if the number of rows in the DB is large, this may result in a giant regex.

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
